text:
Marta Lopez: Following the postmortem, we need one tidy thread for runbook + playbook follow-ups. Main issue: recurring eviction spikes during nightly ETL bulk jobs. Goal: owners, short deadlines, and concrete triage commands.
Liam O'Neil: I'll take the runbook edits (triage steps + escalation path). Target EOD Wed.
Liam O'Neil: Proposing triage commands to include (quick copy/paste):
```bash
# check node memory and pod usage
kubectl top nodes | sort -k3 -nr
kubectl top pods -n inference --containers | grep kv-cache
# check redis memory inside cache pod
kubectl exec -n inference $(kubectl get pod -n inference -l app=kv-cache -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}') -- redis-cli INFO memory | grep used_memory_human
# quick evictions metric (Prometheus)
curl -g 'http://prometheus.monitoring/api/v1/query?query=sum(increase(redis_evicted_keys_total[5m]))'
```
Jared Park: I'll own the RFC for scheduling/backoff on the ETL side and the job gating (coord with Data Infra). RFC due next Tue.
Tess: ops-bot opened INC-2419 and a runbook draft is linked: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runbooks/pull/58
ops-bot: Created Jira INC-2419: "Runbook & job-gating for nightly eviction spikes" assigned to Jared Park, due 2026-04-08.
Nina: For escalation, add explicit page order: infra-oncall -> platform-eng -> SRE lead. Also include Slack channel #incidents as fallback.
Marta Lopez: Nice. Add a short "immediate mitigation" section: scale down model batch_size, enable request-shedding on non-critical routes, and rotate kv-cache pods. Example commands:
```bash
# reduce batch size via API
redwood config set --route /v1/generate --batch_size 8 --reason 'mitigation'
# rotate cache pods
kubectl rollout restart deploy/kv-cache -n inference
```
Liam O'Neil: I'll add those to the runbook. Also adding a checklist item: "If memory > 80% on any gpu node AND redis evictions > 10/min -> execute mitigation flow."
Jared Park: I'll include ETL-side changes: stagger job start times, backoff on errors, add pre-flight health check hitting cache eviction rate before job starts.
Tess: Can someone own a recurring-pattern alert (Grafana/Prometheus)? Suggest query: `sum(increase(redis_evicted_keys_total[10m])) by (job)` with a sliding window and a 2-step alert (warning -> critical).
Nina: I'll take the alert. Will propose alert thresholds and a dashboard panel by next Fri.
Marta Lopez: Summary of owners & deadlines (please copy into INC-2419):
- Runbook triage + escalation edits: Liam O'Neil — due 2026-03-31
- ETL scheduling RFC + job gating: Jared Park — RFC due 2026-04-08
- Grafana/Prometheus recurring-pattern alert: Nina — due 2026-04-02
- Runbook PR review + merge: Tess + Liam — review done by 2026-03-30
Action items: include the commands above in the runbook, add escalation order + who to page, add pre-flight gating for nightly jobs, and create a short playbook cheat-sheet for oncall.
Liam O'Neil: ack. I'll make the runbook items minimal and pasteable for oncall.
Jared Park: I'll link Data Infra owners in the RFC and set milestone for implementation week of 2026-04-12.
Tess: I'll add a PR checklist and assign reviewers. Also will add a short `oncall-cheatsheet.md` for the incidents repo.
ops-bot: INC-2419 updated with owners and due dates.
Marta Lopez: Thanks all. I'll follow up Wednesday to ensure nothing's blocked. If anyone needs pairing on queries/commands, ping me.
Nina: pinged Liam for pairing on alert thresholds later today.
